subject: Trial success playbook & weekly cadence - ClovaTech POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ariela Gomez <ariela.gomez@clovatech.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@clovatech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial success playbook & weekly cadence - ClovaTech POC

Hi Ariela / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned heading into a short proof-of-concept: feel free to comment inline.

Call highlights
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference for ClovaTech live support assistant (intent classification + response generation) across a 30k-turn sample over a 2-week trial.
- Success metrics you asked to prioritize: intent accuracy >= 88% on production traffic proxy, 95th pct latency < 250ms for short-text paths, and acceptable cost-per-1000-tokens target we agreed to discuss in the SOW.
- Data: you confirmed we can use a synthetic subset + anonymized historical transcripts (~15k rows) for initial validation; production hooks will be tested in week 2.

Proposed PoC (high level) — attached: a concise playbook (redwood_poc_playbook.pdf) and a requirements worksheet (clovatech_poc_requirements.xlsx)
1) Kickoff (Day 0): alignment session, access & test accounts, finalize test dataset slice. (Owner: Marissa)
2) Integration sprint (Days 1–3): deploy inference endpoint to your staging VPC, run smoke tests, validate auth. (Owner: Karthik)
3) Eval run (Days 4–10): run steady-state traffic proxy, collect metrics and examples. (Owner: Monica)
4) Readout & decision (Day 14): present results, compare to success criteria, discuss next steps/scale. (Owner: Marissa + ClovaTech)

Weekly cadence suggestion: 30-min syncs on Tuesdays 10am PT (quick blockers + metric check), plus ad-hoc 1:1 with Eng as needed.

Open items for your team
- Confirm final dataset export by Tue 11/16 EOD (format & sample rows in worksheet).
- Confirm which production integrations to test in week 2 (webhook vs. batch).

If that looks good I’ll drop a calendar invite for the kickoff and loop in our solutions engineer (Karthik) and Monica (CSM) on the first working session.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Ariela Gomez <ariela.gomez@clovatech.com>

Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@clovatech.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial success playbook & weekly cadence - ClovaTech POC

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Quick answers inline: 

> 1) Kickoff (Day 0)
We’re good for kickoff on Wed 11/17 at 10am PT.

> Dataset export by Tue 11/16 EOD
I’ll have engineering send a sample CSV by EOD Tuesday; it’ll be anonymized but preserves intent labels.

> Production integrations to test in week 2
Let’s start with webhook (near-real-time) and one batch path for backfill — our platform supports both. We’ll provide the webhook endpoint during the integration sprint.

A couple of clarifying Qs before kickoff:
- For the latency target, does the 250ms include network hop into your hosted endpoint or just inference processing time?
- On the cost-per-1k-token target we discussed, can you share the baseline estimate for the configuration you plan to deploy in staging?

Tom and I can take the kickoff invite. Appreciate the checklist — helps us map internal stakeholders.

— Ariela
Ariela Gomez
Head of Product, ClovaTech

Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial success playbook & weekly cadence - ClovaTech POC

Ariela — great questions, thanks. Below are clarifications plus the detailed milestone schedule we’ll run from kickoff. I’ve attached the filled playbook (redwood_poc_playbook.pdf) and the requirements worksheet with our expected columns filled.

Answers to Qs
- Latency: our 250ms target is for end-to-end median P99 observed at the edge of our serving stack in staging (includes inference processing + config overhead but excludes public internet variability). If you want an on-prem network baseline we can add a traceroute run during the integration sprint.
- Cost baseline: for the staging config we plan to deploy (4x gpus, int8 quantized Llama-variant) estimated billable token cost ~ $2.40 per 1k tokens. We’ll provide a usage dashboard in the console so you can track live.

Detailed milestone schedule (dates are target days relative to kickoff on 2027-11-17)
- Day 0 (2027-11-17): Kickoff (30m), confirm dataset handoff and access. (Owner: Marissa)
- Day 1–2 (11/18–11/19): Staging endpoint deploy + auth; webhook handshake. Smoke tests and sample inference. (Owner: Karthik)
- Day 3–6 (11/20–11/23): Ramp traffic proxy to reach 30k-turn sample; capture intent labels and latency metrics. (Owner: Monica)
- Day 7–12 (11/24–11/29): Extended run for edge cases, cost analysis, and manual review of low-confidence responses (we’ll provide a sample of ~200 flagged responses). (Owner: Monica + Priyom)
- Day 13–14 (11/30–12/01): Final readout, artifacts delivered (metrics dashboard, example set, exportable evaluation CSV), decision review. (Owner: Marissa + ClovaTech)

Weekly touchpoints
- Tue 10:00–10:30 PT — internal/ClovaTech sync (status + blockers)
- Ad-hoc: Solutions deep-dive with Karthik scheduled by request.

Action items for Redwood before kickoff
- Upload a sample runbook and dashboard link to the shared Drive. (Priyom)
- Pre-seed the test environment with a 500-row sample and share the endpoint credentials to ClovaTech engineering. (Karthik)

I’ll send calendar invites for the kickoff and the recurring Tuesday sync. Let us know if any dates conflict.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Marissa

Attachments referenced: redwood_poc_playbook.pdf (updated), clovatech_poc_requirements.xlsx (columns filled)

Subject: Internal: ClovaTech kickoff prep — owners & quick checklist

Team — prepping for kickoff in 3 hours (10am PT). Quick prep notes so we’re synchronized: 

Agenda (30m)- 5m intros & goals- 10m access + dataset confirmation- 10m deployment plan + immediate smoke tests- 5m next steps and scheduling

Owners / checkboxes- Marissa: run intro, confirm acceptance criteria (I’ll cover the success thresholds)- Karthik: have staging endpoint and creds available; plan for webhook handshake; bring minimal curl commands for smoke tests- Monica: confirm monitoring dashboard, set up metric collection for intents & latency; prepare sample review flow for low-confidence responses- Priyom: upload runbook + example eval notebook to Drive link and watch logs during smoke test

Attachments we should have accessible: redwood_poc_playbook.pdf, clovatech_poc_requirements.xlsx

If anything is missing ping me on Slack and I’ll triage.

— Marissa

Marissa / team — great kickoff this morning, thanks for the tight run. Two quick confirmations from our side after the smoke tests: 

- Dataset sample uploaded (see clovatech_poc_requirements.xlsx) — format looks good, label column present.
- Webhook handshake succeeded; first 300 requests processed with median latency ~210ms (good visibility on our side).

We’ll confirm a full 30k-turn proxy by Monday 11/22. Tom will coordinate with our infra team for the batch path test in week 2.

Next steps (agreed)
1) Redwood: provide the dashboard link and the exportable evaluation CSV by EOD Friday (Owner: Monica)
2) ClovaTech: confirm batch ingestion schedule for week 2 (Owner: Tom)
3) Joint: mid-run review Wed 11/24 — 30m check-in to review samples and early metrics

Appreciate the concise owners list — makes it easy to escalate internally. Looking forward to the readout.

Best,
Ariela
